verdict.rationale: The evidence shows a general REST API with bearer-token auth, SDKs, list endpoints, an OpenAPI spec and an llms.txt. Those are developer building blocks a team could wrap into agent tooling. Nothing documents an agent-facing capability, such as an MCP server or agent query interface, for answering billing-state questions. There is also no evidence of endpoints that surface MRR, delinquent accounts or upcoming renewals.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, an agent can answer questions about my billing state — MRR, delinquent accounts, upcoming renewals, a customer's invoices — by querying the platform directly
